categories.main_business_segments: Xiangyu Medical primarily operates in the rehabilitation medical device industry, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and service of rehabilitation medical equipment. The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering rehabilitation physiotherapy, training, nursing, aids, assessment, traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment, health care, medical aesthetics, rehabilitation furniture, and home rehabilitation. It provides integrated clinical rehabilitation solutions and professional technical support services to medical institutions, elderly care facilities, disability rehabilitation centers, welfare institutions, educational systems, and families across China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technological innovation with core technologies in shockwave therapy, magnetic therapy, phototherapy, electrotherapy, robotics, brain-computer interfaces (BCI), AI medical applications, and multi-physical factor integrated therapies. It has developed proprietary technologies such as intelligent rehabilitation robots, non-invasive brain-computer interface devices, and modular integrated rehabilitation equipment. Production follows ISO13485 medical device quality management standards, with a complete industrial internet platform supporting digitalized manufacturing and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xiangyu Medical serves a broad range of customers including hospitals, rehabilitation centers, elderly care institutions, disability organizations, educational institutions, sports systems, welfare homes, and individual consumers for home rehabilitation. Its products address clinical needs in pain management, orthopedic rehabilitation, neurological rehabilitation, post-operative recovery, cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, mental health, and traditional Chinese medicine rehabilitation. The company also targets international markets, especially countries along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with sales coverage across 31 provincial-level regions and over 300 prefecture-level areas. It has established R&D centers in multiple Chinese cities including Zhengzhou, Tianjin, Nanjing, Chengdu, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Xi'an. Internationally, Xiangyu Medical exports products to over 30 countries and regions including Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Central Asia, South America, and Africa, and actively participates in global medical device exhibitions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiangyu Medical operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the rehabilitation medical device supply chain. It controls the entire value chain from independent R&D, manufacturing, to sales and after-sales service. The company also manages procurement and supply of key components and materials, ensuring quality and cost control across its production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven innovation with significant R&D investment (20.45% of revenue in 2024). Strategic R&D focuses include brain-computer interfaces, rehabilitation robotics, AI medical solutions, and integrated multi-physical factor therapies. Xiangyu Medical fosters industry-academia collaboration, operates multiple innovation labs, and leads national key research projects. It aims to accelerate technology commercialization and expand product lines to meet clinical and market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Xiangyu Medical generates revenue primarily through product sales of rehabilitation medical devices and related equipment. Sales are conducted mainly via indirect channels (distributors and agents) and direct sales to institutional and individual customers. The company also explores e-commerce sales targeting home rehabilitation consumers. Revenue streams include domestic and international sales, with some income from technical services and after-sales support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xiangyu Medical is positioned as a leading R&D-driven comprehensive rehabilitation medical device manufacturer in China. It holds a strong market position with a broad product portfolio, extensive sales network, and recognized brand. The company competes with other domestic and international rehabilitation device manufacturers but differentiates itself through its integrated clinical solutions, advanced technologies like BCI and robotics, and strong patent portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Xiangyu Medical reported revenue of approximately RMB 743.5 million, nearly flat compared to the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 102.9 million, down 54.68% due to increased R&D and personnel costs. Total assets grew by 12.95% to RMB 2.93 billion, while net assets slightly decreased by 2.5% to RMB 2.04 billion. The company maintains a stable dividend payout policy and has actively repurchased shares to enhance shareholder value.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiangyu Medical emphasizes its technology innovation leadership, comprehensive product range, and integrated clinical rehabilitation solutions as key differentiators. The company offers advanced, intelligent rehabilitation devices incorporating AI, robotics, and brain-computer interface technologies, tailored to diverse clinical needs. Its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and national-level certifications underpin product quality and innovation, delivering superior rehabilitation outcomes and supporting the development of smart, personalized rehabilitation services.
